name: 髪の動力学分析
description: AI生成ビデオのアーティファクトを検出するために、自然な髪の動きの物理と一貫性を分析します。
useCase: Detecting deepfakes through unnatural hair behavior and rendering artifacts
mechanism: Tracks hair strand movement, flow patterns, and physical plausibility across frames. AI-generated videos often exhibit hair that clips through solid objects, moves unrealistically, lacks natural physics simulation, or shows temporal incoherence in strand-level details.
source: Verdoliva, L. (2020) - Media Forensics and DeepFakes: An Overview, IEEE JSTSP
algorithm: Hair Segmentation + Motion Field Analysis + Physical Plausibility Scoring
parameters: Segmentation model: U-Net variant, Motion estimation: dense optical flow, Physics check: gravity, inertia constraints
